ConnectionStrings._comment: The agent's own database, separate from App1's. Copy the Server= value from App1's DefaultConnection; keep Database=ZKAgent. It is created automatically on first run.

Central._comment: App1. localhost while both run on this PC. Change to App1 machine's LAN IP (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:5107/) only when App2 moves to the office PC.
